run_relax_atoms_basic: run relax_atoms on ASE Atoms with a calculator to get relaxed atomic structure
run_relax_atoms_with_fmax: run relax_atoms with a custom fmax convergence threshold for tighter force tolerance
run_relax_atoms_with_optimizer: run relax_atoms with a custom ASE optimizer class instead of the default FIRE optimizer
run_relax_atoms_fix_symmetry: run relax_atoms with fix_symmetry enabled to constrain structure symmetry during relaxation
run_relax_atoms_with_observers: run relax_atoms with observer callbacks attached to monitor optimization progress at intervals
